issue.title: Retire link_events
issue.description: Publish artifact-link mutations through immutable link event objects.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The event lane has soaked through the artifact-link cutover epic with both-state writer, hidden-clone, and retry coverage, so the legacy index-writing branch can be deleted.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Artifact-link writers keep the current legacy index-writing and outbox projection behavior.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Artifact-link writers enqueue or publish immutable link event objects through hidden machine-owned document stores instead of dirtying agent-checkout link indexes.

payload.entry: Verified: registry entry for link_events is already removed (sase flag show link_events: unknown feature flag) and no Off-branch/conditional code references it (grep across src/ for link_events shows only the event-publication call sites, no flag registry or branch). The artifact-link event lane has soaked through the sase-yy.8 repair phases (producer identity, publication durability, event reconciliation, cutover recovery) with acceptance coverage extended in sase-yy.8.5: real production-producer identity freezing, a genuine killed-process object-installation recovery test, real separate agent-checkout/hidden-store CLI mutation-path tests, a multi-root cutover-resume-after-partial-marker-failure test, and a v1-outbox-preservation regression test. tools/check_feature_flags rule 8 was failing just check because the bead had no registry definition; closing it is the correct resolution since the flag was already fully removed, not re-added.
